A pattern is only promoted or flagged as failing when the 90% confidence interval clears zero with at least 20 (promote) or 12 (flag) closed trades. Flagged patterns keep running and alerting: nothing is switched off automatically.

summary: Runner study: 135 closed paper trades, average -6.7% (median -20.2%, 15% won, -8.1% without the single best trade).
Risk rules: Listed (-4.1%) and dropped (-11%) coins did about the same so far.

Numbers that reliably separated winners from losers (luck-corrected): 24h change over 100% (+388429.4% against +121.2%); Hour of day (UTC) 12-18 (+310741.5% against +128.7%); 24h change under 25% (-12.1% against +176829.9%).
Against random coins: The runners list (-4.1%) and random coins (+76022.9%) did about the same so far.
Locked test (from 2026-10-25): 0 of 7 rules found before the lock date also held on 107 later trades.
Week by week: 24h change over 100% pointed the same way in 2 of 2 weeks; Hour of day (UTC) 12-18 pointed the same way in 2 of 2 weeks.

Risk: at 10% of the account per trade the listed runners had a worst drawdown of 37.6% and a longest losing run of 22. A size of about 6.7% per trade would keep 24 losses in a row under a 30% account hit.
Progress: 135 of 30 closed trades needed before reading results (0 to go).
Exit study: "stop 15%" averaged +0.1% against -4.5% for the current exit over 66 trades. Treat it as a hint until it holds on more trades.
